table: County Authority: authority level, home rule option and Dillon's Rule flexibilities by state (Counties 101, Module 2 charts)
title: County structure, authority and finances: county authority state profiles
universe: County governments in the 48 states that have them
geography: All 56 places, keyed by postal code; CT and RI have no county government; DC and the five territories have no county tier
limits: A state's overall rating on NACo's six-point scale from 1 (most restrictive, Dillon's Rule) to 6 (most flexible, home rule); it describes the state's counties as a whole, not each county or each subject. Mixed states (levels 2 and 5) hold both home rule and Dillon's Rule counties; which county is which is in each state's profile PDF, not read here. The chart's own note reads "Source: NACo Research, 2022".
pageQuotes: Currently, in 14 states, all counties operate under the more restrictive Dillon's Rule
13 states grant all counties Home Rule authority.
The remaining 21 states with county governments have a mix of Home Rule and Dillon's Rule counties.
readBy: scripts/research/check-core-research.ts (checks coverage and scale); the builder item core-policy-authority-limited-cell-predicates reads it into the county cells' conditions.

AL.quote: Most Alabama counties are governed by general law authority, and therefore have only the powers and structures provided to them by the state legislature.

AK.quote: Boroughs in Alaska may adopt a home rule charter, with the approval of voters, which allows the boroughs’ government broad legislative powers not prohibited by state law.

AZ.quote: All Arizona counties are governed under Dillon’s Rule, and are limited to the authorities the state legislature explicitly grants.

AR.homeRuleOption: N/A - All Counties Already Under Home Rule
AR.dillonsRuleFlexibilities: N/A - All Counties Under Home Rule
AR.quote: Counties in the state of Arkansas are authorized to determine their own government structure.

CO.quote: Most Colorado counties are governed by Dillon’s Rule authority and are limited to the authorities the state legislature explicitly grants.

CT.note: No county government: NACo's profiles cover the 48 states with county governments (14 all Dillon's Rule, 13 all home rule, 21 mixed), and this place is not among them.

DE.homeRuleRestrictions: N/A - All Counties Under Dillon's Rule
DE.quote: Delaware counties do not have charters, home rule authority or power to alter their government structure.

DC.note: No county government in NACo's 48 states; the authority reader reads this place's own column (dc or territory), never a county cell, so no county level applies.

FL.quote: Counties in Florida may submit to its voters the option of adopting a home rule charter.

GA.homeRuleOption: N/A - All Counties Already Under Home Rule
GA.dillonsRuleFlexibilities: N/A - All Counties Under Home Rule
GA.quote: Georgia counties are granted home rule powers through the Georgia Constitution.

HI.dillonsRuleFlexibilities: N/A - All Counties Under Home Rule
HI.quote: The four counties within the state of Hawaii all operate under home rule, an option granted in the state’s constitution for all political subdivisions.

ID.homeRuleRestrictions: N/A - All Counties Under Dillon's Rule
ID.quote: All counties in Idaho are governed under Dillon’s Rule.

IL.quote: Illinois counties are under Dillon’s Rule, with only the powers expressly granted to them by the state, whether they have a county executive or not.

IN.homeRuleOption: N/A - All Counties Already Under Home Rule
IN.dillonsRuleFlexibilities: N/A - All Counties Under Home Rule
IN.quote: Counties in Indiana have home rule power and the authority to determine their local affairs and government structure so long as it is consistent with state law.

IA.homeRuleOption: N/A - All Counties Already Under Home Rule
IA.dillonsRuleFlexibilities: N/A - All Counties Under Home Rule
IA.quote: Counties or joint county-municipal corporation governments in Iowa have home rule power and authority to determine their local affairs and government so long as it is consistent with state law.

KS.homeRuleOption: N/A - All Counties Already Under Home Rule
KS.dillonsRuleFlexibilities: N/A - All Counties Under Home Rule

KY.quote: Most counties in Kentucky are governed under general law and therefore only have powers specifically granted by the state legislature.

LA.quote: Twenty-six (26) of the 64 parishes in Louisiana operate under a home rule charter which grants them the authority to determine their local affairs, organization, powers, functions and structure so long as they are consistent with state law.

ME.dillonsRuleFlexibilities: N/A - All Counties Under Home Rule
ME.quote: All counties in Maine have adopted a home rule charter which empowers them to determine their structure of government, officers, departments and more.

MD.quote: Counties in Maryland may operate under a traditional commissioner form of government, a code home rule form or a home rule charter.

MA.quote: Massachusetts has four Dillon’s rule counties, one Dillon’s rule city-county consolidated government, one home rule county and one home rule city-county consolidated government.

MI.quote: Counties in Michigan may have one of four structures – general law, unified with a county manager, unified with an elected executive and a charter government.

MN.quote: All county governments, except for Ramsey County, are under general law and therefore only have the powers and structures prescribed to them by Minnesota state law.

MS.homeRuleOption: N/A - All Counties Already Under Home Rule
MS.dillonsRuleFlexibilities: N/A - All Counties Under Home Rule
MS.quote: The Mississippi state legislature adopted a home rule provision in 1989, delegating greater authority to counties in determining local affairs, property and finances if it is not expressly forbidden by state law.

MO.quote: Most counties in Missouri are subject to general law and therefore are only allowed the powers, structure and authority granted by the state legislature.

MT.quote: Counties in Montana may opt for either a charter or non-charter form of government.

NE.homeRuleRestrictions: N/A - All Counties Under Dillon's Rule

NV.homeRuleOption: N/A - All Counties Already Under Home Rule
NV.dillonsRuleFlexibilities: N/A - All Counties Under Home Rule
NV.quote: All counties in Nevada have been granted limited administrative “Home Rule.” Counties have a limited authority to pass ordinances and provide services and functions to address local matters that are not otherwise governed or addressed by state legislation.

NH.homeRuleRestrictions: N/A - All Counties Under Dillon's Rule
NH.quote: All counties within New Hampshire are governed under Dillon’s Rule and therefore have only the authority that is explicitly extended by state law.

NJ.quote: Despite home rule not being granted by name, the New Jersey constitution establishes that constitutional and statutory provisions for county governance are construed liberally in the favor of counties.

NM.homeRuleRestrictions: N/A - All Counties Under Dillon's Rule
NM.quote: Counties in New Mexico are governed under general law.

NY.homeRuleOption: N/A - All Counties Already Under Home Rule
NY.dillonsRuleFlexibilities: N/A - All Counties Under Home Rule

NC.homeRuleRestrictions: N/A - All Counties Under Dillon's Rule
NC.quote: In general, counties or joint city-county governments in North Carolina are not granted home rule power and may only exercise the powers that have been explicitly granted by the state.

ND.quote: In North Dakota, 12 counties have adopted a home rule charter and 41 are governed under Dillon’s Rule.

OH.quote: Almost all counties in Ohio are governed under Dillon’s rule and therefore have only the authority that is explicitly extended to them by state law.

OK.homeRuleRestrictions: N/A - All Counties Under Dillon's Rule
OK.quote: All counties within Oklahoma are governed under general law and therefore have only the authority that is explicitly extended to them by the state.

OR.homeRuleOption: N/A - All Counties Already Under Home Rule
OR.dillonsRuleFlexibilities: N/A - All Counties Under Home Rule
OR.quote: All 36 Oregon counties have home rule power, meaning counties may take any action consistent with federal or state law.

PA.quote: Most Pennsylvania counties are governed under Dillon’s Rule and therefore only have powers authorized by the state legislature, but the state also allows counties to adopt home rule charters.

RI.note: No county government: NACo's profiles cover the 48 states with county governments (14 all Dillon's Rule, 13 all home rule, 21 mixed), and this place is not among them.

SC.homeRuleOption: N/A - All Counties Already Under Home Rule
SC.dillonsRuleFlexibilities: N/A - All Counties Under Home Rule
SC.quote: Counties in South Carolina were granted constitutional home rule in 1975.

SD.homeRuleRestrictions: N/A - All Counties Under Dillon's Rule
SD.quote: Most counties in South Dakota are governed under general law and therefore only have powers explicitly granted by the state legislature.

TN.quote: Most counties in Tennessee are governed under general law, but counties are also permitted to adopt a home rule charter through a vote by qualified electors.

TX.homeRuleRestrictions: N/A - All Counties Under Dillon's Rule
TX.quote: Texas counties are all governed by Dillon’s rule and therefore may only exercise the powers and authorities that have been explicitly granted by the state legislature and those reasonably implied therefrom.

UT.homeRuleRestrictions: N/A - All Counties Under Dillon's Rule
UT.quote: Utah counties are unique in that they are governed under Hutchinson’s Rule, named after a seminal 1980 case, State v.

VT.homeRuleRestrictions: N/A - All Counties Under Dillon's Rule
VT.quote: Vermont counties are governed under Dillon’s Rule and therefore are only afforded the authorities that are explicitly provided by state legislature.

VA.homeRuleRestrictions: N/A - All Counties Under Dillon's Rule
VA.quote: Counties in Virginia are governed by Dillon’s rule.

WA.quote: Washington counties may create a home rule charter subject to state laws.

WV.homeRuleRestrictions: N/A - All Counties Under Dillon's Rule
WV.quote: All counties in West Virginia are governed under Dillon’s Rule and therefore have only the authority and government structure explicitly provided by state legislature.

WI.homeRuleOption: N/A - All Counties Already Under Home Rule
WI.dillonsRuleFlexibilities: N/A - All Counties Under Home Rule
WI.quote: Wisconsin counties have administrative home rule and therefore have the authority to exercise both organizational and administrative power.

WY.homeRuleRestrictions: N/A - All Counties Under Dillon's Rule
WY.quote: Counties are authorized only with the power expressly granted by state law.
